## Change / 修改

Describe the problem and scope. 說明問題與修改範圍。

## Evidence / 驗證

State exact tests run and what remains untested. 區分替身、真模型、GPU／相機測試。

- [ ] Application tests / 應用測試
- [ ] English and Traditional Chinese kept consistent / 英文與繁體中文同步
- [ ] Raw depth, units and intrinsics preserved / 原始深度、單位及內參保留
- [ ] Public manifest updated; no credentials or private images / 更新公開清單且不含帳密與私人畫面
- [ ] Dependencies and adapted/generated code disclosed / 說明依賴與外部改寫、生成程式來源

## Limitations / 限制

List hardware/model paths not tested. 明列未驗證的硬體與模型路徑。
